seed_expert_discoveries.project: Frontier LLM Capabilities in Scientific Discovery
seed_expert_discoveries.technical_takeaway: LLMs excel at out-of-distribution problems by compressing reasoning structures and learning universe patterns (not memorization); evidenced by AlphaProof (IMO silver via Lean search), FunSearch (new math via proposal+checker), and AlphaFold-style generalization to unseen proteins via physics simulation.
Continued community-driven growth in LangGraph for building agentic systems, with emphasis on ongoing iteration based on user feedback.
